// AUTO-GENERATED outer-tiled MX matmul optimized solution.
void solution(void) {
  // Global config setup
  gemmini_flush(0);
  gemmini_extended3_config_ex(WEIGHT_STATIONARY, 0, 0, ACC_SCALE_IDENTITY, 1, 1, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 3, 0);

  // Outer loop over weight blocks (J dimension)
  for (int j0 = 0; j0 < BLOCKS_N; j0++) {
    int ncols = REAL_N - j0 * BLK; 
    if (ncols > BLK) ncols = BLK; 
    if (ncols <= 0) continue;

    int tiles_J = (ncols + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Ceiling division
    int tiles_K = MATMUL_K / DIM;
    int padded_ncols = tiles_J * DIM; // Pad to multiple of DIM
    
    // Calculate B base address at top of scratchpad
    uint32_t b_base = BANK_NUM * BANK_ROWS - tiles_J * tiles_K * DIM;

    // 1. Hoist and stage weight scale factors once per j0
    for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
      memcpy(&B_s[g][0], &B_scales_col[g][j0 * BLK], padded_ncols);
    }
    gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)B_s, B_S_BYTES, 1);

    // 2. Hoist and MVIN weight (B) tiles once per j0
    gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_N * sizeof(elem_t)); // B rows: stride N
    for (int j = 0; j < tiles_J; j++) { // B[k][j0*BLK+j] -> slot (k*tiles_J + j)
      for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
        gemmini_extended_mvin2((void*)(((elem_t*)B_in) + (k * DIM) * MATMUL_N + (j0 * BLK + j * DIM)),
                               b_base + (k * tiles_J + j) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
      }
    }

    // Inner loop over activation blocks (I dimension)
    for (int i0 = 0; i0 < BLOCKS_M; i0++) {
      int mrows = REAL_M - i0 * BLK; 
      if (mrows > BLK) mrows = BLK; 
      if (mrows <= 0) continue;

      int tiles_I = (mrows + DIM - 1) / DIM; // Ceiling division
      int padded_mrows = tiles_I * DIM; // Pad to multiple of DIM
      
      uint32_t a_base = 0;
      int SPAD_DEST = 0; // Place output at bottom of scratchpad
      int pad_i = padded_mrows - mrows, pad_j = padded_ncols - ncols;

      // 3. Stage and load activation scale factors for this i0
      for (int g = 0; g < MATMUL_K / 32; g++) {
        memcpy(&A_s[g][0], &A_scales_row[g][i0 * BLK], padded_mrows);
      }
      gemmini_mx_load_scales((uint64_t)A_s, A_S_BYTES, 0);

      // 4. MVIN activation (A) tiles for this i0
      gemmini_config_ld(MATMUL_K * sizeof(elem_t)); // A rows: stride K
      for (int i = 0; i < tiles_I; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < tiles_K; k++) {
          gemmini_extended_mvin((void*)(((elem_t*)A_in) + (i0 * BLK + i * DIM) * MATMUL_K + k * DIM),
                                a_base + (i * tiles_K + k) * DIM, DIM, DIM);
        }
      }

      // 5. Configure output strides and requantizer
      gemmini_config_st(padded_ncols * sizeof(out_t));
      gemmini_mxquant_config_mvout((uint64_t)scale_factors, tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, 0, 0, 1);

      // 6. Run compute using skips=0x38 to bypass redundant DRAM preloads of stationary weights
      gemmini_loop_ws_spad(tiles_I, tiles_J, tiles_K, pad_i, pad_j, 0, a_base, b_base, 0,
                           SPAD_DEST, false, false, false, false, false, NO_ACTIVATION, 0, 0, false, 0x38);

      // 7. Drain the BF16 packed outputs to host memory
      int total_bf16_elements = padded_mrows * padded_ncols;
      gemmini_mx_read_smem((uint64_t)C_hw + (i0 * BLK * REAL_N + j0 * BLK) * sizeof(out_t), 
                          SPAD_DEST * 16, total_bf16_elements);
      gemmini_fence();
    }
  }
}
